## Objective
- Complete the game in the repository. The original saved request describes “a reality, inside a dream that falls apart”; the latest request asks to continue and finish the game.

## Requirements
- Deliver a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Built **Elsewhere**, a dreamlike platform game: collect six memories, cross collapsing platforms, and reach the exit.
- Used a canvas-based game with responsive touch controls, keyboard controls, pause and sound toggles, and a short ending.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game page, styling, and gameplay implementation.
- Verified `game.js` parses with `node --check`.
- Tested desktop play and mobile controls in Chromium; no page errors observed.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/elsewhere.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work; the user’s request appears implemented, but no final completion response was sent.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check `git status --short` and `git diff --check`.
2. Briefly report the completed game, controls, test results, and reasonable assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game UI, title/end/pause screens, and control elements.
